Description: Lash Her application deployment access - operate tagged Lightsail hosts without infrastructure bootstrap or IAM administration.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: Operator assumes a short-lived role for SSH application releases to administrator-provisioned Lightsail hosts.
must: Trust only the named operator in this account; no CI federation until exact protected workflow claims exist.
Host writes and temporary SSH access require Project=lash-her and Environment=staging or production.
The operator role cannot create, delete, retag, or reconfigure host firewalls, manage IAM, or read stored secrets.
Cloud workloads are not provisioned by this stack.

OperatorUserName.Description: Existing IAM user permitted to assume the deployment role.

DeploymentRoleName.Description: Stable role name referenced by the local deployment profile.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: A stable named role supports the local role profile. Separate bootstrap authority prevents deployment automation from claiming unrelated hosts through tags.
must: No resource creation or ownership-tag mutation permissions.
The four resource-level actions require both ownership and environment tags.
All permitted Lightsail operations use the stack region; metadata reads require wildcard resources because Lightsail does not support resource-level scoping for these APIs.
Keep the temporary SSH-access response inside a deployment process; it contains private credentials.

Properties.Description: Application releases to owned Lash Her Lightsail hosts; infrastructure bootstrap remains separate.

DeploymentRoleArn.Description: Role assumed by the lash-her-deploy CLI profile.

DeploymentRegion.Description: Only this region is allowed for Lightsail operations.

RequiredHostTags.Description: A bootstrap administrator must set these tags before role-based host deployment is possible.
